title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the Sprinters Stakes. In response to the videos she filmed during training…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is receiving support from an entirely different fan base from before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Curren Chan is racing against a formidable opponent today… one who is also gaining popularity on Umatter—Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is determined to beat her and prove that she is the cutest.
